wish_topics.evidence_span: I'd want people to be better able to stay in contact with what's real for other people, especially when it's inconvenient
It comes from distance: people who never see the consequences of a policy, a purchase, or a offhand cruelty, and who can't imagine the person on the other side well enough for it to weigh on them
I'd want to shrink that distance without flattening people into agreement
Factory farming, neglected diseases, bureaucratic indifference, and dehumanizing enemies all seem to run on the same fuel: not seeing clearly, or being able to look away
I mean the capacity to hold someone else's reality as vivid and as weighty as your own, long enough to let it change what you do
The more obvious answer would be to end a specific horror, like childhood disease or hunger. I'd take that in a heartbeat if it were the choice
